_: #9 instance globals (UpdateCurrentInstanceGlobal) — a gather/count radiant quest. The startUpStage fragment rolls a random target into MF_ItemTotal, zeroes MF_ItemCount, and binds BOTH to this quest INSTANCE so the objective text '<Global=MF_ItemCount>/<Global=MF_ItemTotal>' shows per-instance numbers. That instance binding is what lets one template run many times at once with different counts (Missives' core trick). The script that increments MF_ItemCount on pickup is the author's (this demo only sets up the counters + objective). Build with `package` so the generated MF_Gather_Stages.psc compiles and the QuestAdapter binds the GLOB properties.

stages.logEntry: Collect the goods for the client.
stages._: On start: roll target 3..6 into MF_ItemTotal, zero the running MF_ItemCount, bind both to this instance.

objectives._: <Global=...> reads the instance-bound values, so each running copy shows its own X/Y.
